Validate GTAP Files (Internal)

Source: R/help_GTAPauto.R
dot-validate_gtap_files.Rd

Validates input files, mapping configurations, case names, and output formats for GTAP processing.

Usage

.validate_gtap_files(
  input_dir,
  output_dir,
  experiment,
  mapping_info,
  sl4var,
  harvar,
  sl4map,
  harmap,
  output_formats,
  plot_data,
  sl4_file_suffix = ".sl4",
  har_file_suffix = "-WEL.har"
)

Arguments

input_dir

Character. Path to folder containing GTAP input files.

output_dir

Character. Path where output files will be saved.

experiment

Character vector. Case names (experiment names) to validate.

mapping_info

Character. Mapping mode: "GTAPv7", "Yes", "No", or "Mix".

sl4var

Logical. Whether SL4 data should be processed.

harvar

Logical. Whether HAR data should be processed.

sl4map

Data frame, NULL, or FALSE. Mapping for SL4 variables.

harmap

Data frame, NULL, or FALSE. Mapping for HAR variables.

output_formats

Character vector. Export formats (e.g., c("csv", "stata")).

plot_data

Logical. Whether to generate plots without exporting data.

sl4_file_suffix

Character. Suffix for SL4 files (e.g., "" or "-custom").

har_file_suffix

Character. Suffix for HAR files (e.g., "-WEL").

Value

A list with three elements:

status

Character indicating validation status ("ok", "error", or "warning").

messages

Character vector of validation messages.

proceed

Logical indicating whether processing should continue.

See also

auto_gtap_data
